## Falsifiable change claim

Describe the equation, cost assumption, source admission or inference being amended. Identify the prior model, new model, unit of analysis, expected measurable effect and predeclared failure criterion.

## Exact evidence and provenance

Identify the source-pinned rows, source licence, true observed outcome labels, original commit/blob hash, possible data overlap, and whether every proposed feature was available at estimation time. Explicitly say when a source is not yet independently authenticated.

## Independent evaluation

Show baseline and challenger errors on every eligible dataset, including negative/null results and excluded records. Link the `docomo-projects` / `docomo-scrutiny` CI artifacts. If making a forward-looking AI-native claim, include the frozen `protocol-freeze` definition, provider-checked `github-attest` timestamp, all-attempt intake census, source ledger audit, and untouched repository-level evaluation.

## Counterexamples and unintended effects

Identify adversarial cases, regression domains, failure acceptance changes, inference expenditure, time/verification burdens, and unknown grounding. A change that improves one score but worsens independent acceptance or total engineering cost is not automatically acceptable.

## Reversibility

Describe version changes, deployment scope, monitoring, drift criteria and rollback. State which release gates are unsupported. A green retrospective CI is **not** a certificate of calibrated AI-native project effort.
